description: This file defines the class ANTLRStringStream, which implements the CharStream interface for handling character streams in a parser or lexer, including methods for consuming characters, marking positions, rewinding, seeking, and retrieving substrings.

classes.name: ANTLRStringStream
classes.description: A class implementing CharStream for managing character input streams with support for marking, rewinding, and seeking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream with input string, converting it to an integer array and setting initial position and line info.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stream to its initial state without changing the data.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Advances the stream by one character, updating line and position counters.

methods.name: LA
methods.description: Returns the character at a lookahead position relative to current position.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current position index in the stream.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the input data.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks the current position in the stream for backtracking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to a previously marked position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the current position to a specified index, consuming characters if necessary.

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Returns a substring of the input data between start and stop indices.

methods.name: getCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Returns the current character position in the line.

methods.name: setCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Sets the character position in the current line.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name associated with the stream.
